summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new Media Library and Products (Webshop) modules. All critical features are working correctly. Products CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) fully functional with Dutch UI. Media Library upload and picker integration working properly.

minor.issue: Code calls $file->getClientMimeType() after $file->move() which should fail since file is moved, but appears to work in Laravel 11. Consider storing mimeType before move for safety.

issues: Tailwind CDN warning - should use production build for production deployment (existing issue from iteration_2)

critical_code_review_comments: ProductController::uploadImage() calls getClientMimeType() after file->move() - while it works in Laravel 11, it's safer to store mimeType before moving the file
Consider adding image_id foreign key constraint to products table for referential integrity with media_DO table
seed_data_creation: Test products created and deleted during testing. Test image uploaded to media library (test_image.png - blue 100x100px). Final state: 1 product 'Test Product With Image' exists for jan@demo-fotograaf.nl client.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Products and Media Library modules fully tested and working. Products table uses SQLite (same as rest of app). File uploads go to /public/uploads/{client_id}/. Media picker in product forms shows thumbnails with radio buttons for selection. All Dutch language UI. Price formatting uses Dutch convention (comma as decimal separator: EUR 29,99). Both direct image upload in product form AND selecting from media library work correctly.
